Root Rots Fungal diseases that cause decay and rotting of the root. May affect plant stands Crop rotation, improved soil drainage, and seed treatments are effective control options. Yellows Yellow discoloration of plants. Carried by leafhoppers. Cover plants with fabric mulch. No known control.
